prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized city / settlement marker. Three conical spires of decreasing
height sitting on a simple rectangular base block — center spire
tallest, two flanking spires shorter. Simplified app-icon geometry:
flat saturated color fills, sharp clean edges. Each spire is a simple
triangular shape; the base is a solid rectangle. Optional two small
rectangular "window" shapes on the base in a secondary palette color.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat vector app icon; bold geometric silhouette; centered on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; crisp sharp edges throughout; modern UI icon register — Phosphor Fill style; no gradients, no textures, no brushwork
SUBJECT: stylized city settlement marker; three conical triangular spires sitting on a solid rectangular base block; center spire tallest, two flanking spires shorter and symmetrical; each spire rendered as a clean flat triangle; base is a solid filled rectangle; two small rectangular window shapes on the base face
CONTEXT: isolated app icon, map marker asset, readable at 16px minimum
COLOR: center spire in bold red #FF0000; two flanking spires in bold blue #0000FF; rectangular base block in bold blue #0000FF; two small window rectangles on the base in yellow #FFFF00; off-white #FFFFFF canvas background
DETAILS: every edge crisp and deliberate vector geometry; shapes simplified to essential silhouette; window rectangles rendered as flat secondary-color filled shapes; all elements share the same flat fill weight with zero inner shadow or bevel; icon centered with equal padding on all four sides; total composition readable as a strong bold silhouette at 16px
CONSTRAINTS: flat bold color fills only; no gradients; no textures; no ink strokes; no painterly rendering; no cartoon softening; no drop shadows; no border frame
